purpose: Three new distinct healer character concepts, not costume-only variants of the sprout girl.

records.label: A 花瓣药匣
records.prompt:
Design ONE NEW Chinese fantasy FEMALE HEALER for the GameXXK party, entirely different from the green-bob sprout-leaf girl. User wants NEW CHARACTER DESIGN alternatives, not variations of her dress.
Images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image1 approved project character clean contour/standing presentation; image2 actual healing gem bold color/volume. Copy neither character identity, costume, age/body from image1 nor the gem as anatomy.
Full-body compact stylized young female healer with a friendly nonsexual wholesome presentation, clear approximately four-head game proportions, distinct face and hairstyle specified below. Calm front-three-quarter SCREEN LEFT STANDING pose, both feet planted, one supporting leg and other softly relaxed, hands anatomically correct and clearly holding the healing prop. No hopping, airborne knee, stretched side arms or twisted backwards body.
Project GEM ICON art: strong dark controlled contour, 2–3 BIG coherent matte light/shadow groups per material, substantial graphic volumes, few large costume shapes, low detail density. No tiny triangle mosaic, noise, glitter, real eyes, elaborate embroidery or soft blurry painting. Full opaque practical Chinese clothing, no sensual pose or exaggerated anatomy.
No twin giant sprout leaves, green bob, white cheek pom-poms, original black/gold tabard or copied red bow from the previous girl. Express pharmacist role with one dominant medicinal object and simple herb motif, no clutter of every possible prop.
One complete character and props inside a square warm-ivory plain canvas with 8 percent safe margin, no scroll, calligraphy brush, scenery, text, title, watermark or extra people. DESIGN A — WHITE PEONY MEDICINE CASE / 花瓣药匣. Gentle calm healer with pearl-white short softly curved bob, broad petal-shaped side fringe and ONE small pale-rose peony ornament above the ear, no ponytail or sprout crown. Gray-violet simple kind eyes, softly oval face and small closed-mouth smile.
Palette warm IVORY, dusty ROSE, dark plum, a tiny sage accent. Chinese ivory cross-collar short jacket, a SMALL rounded rose shoulder cape shaped as THREE broad overlapping peony petals, plain dark-plum waist sash, modest below-knee layered ivory skirt with one broad rose under-panel, opaque pale stockings and plain low plum cloth shoes.
Dominant prop: ONE round flattened dark-plum lacquer MEDICINE CASE cradled with both hands at the lower waist, decorated by one simple ivory five-petal flower mark and a modest brass latch; clear volume and correct supporting fingers. It should look like a practical portable pill/herb box, not a purse covered in gems. One small cloth sachet at belt only.
Silhouette organized by a quiet rounded head, short petal shoulder, clear narrow waist and gentle bell skirt. Keep petals few and broad, no frill rows, no leaf-like twin pigtails. A warm elegant healer with purposeful round shapes and clear medicinal identity.

DESIGN B — BAMBOO HERB GATHERER / 竹篓采药. A capable quietly friendly healer with DEEP INK-GREEN hair swept into ONE tidy high COILED BUN, a single straight bamboo hairpin, broad diagonal fringe and one short cheek lock. No white bob, giant sprouts or side pigtails. Amber-brown focused simple eyes, short oval face and calm small smile.
Palette moss GREEN, warm IVORY, dark WOOD BROWN and charcoal, tiny dull brass accents. Short ivory crossover tunic with narrow green standing collar and one asymmetric rectangular bamboo-green shoulder cape, sleeves gathered into broad plain cuffs to free the hands. Wide plain dark-green waist sash, two unequal leaf-tapered knee-length coat panels over full ivory tapered trousers, sturdy low green cloth boots. One large simple bamboo-joint band motif on the hem, no repeated tiny leaves.
Dominant prop: tall compact BAMBOO MEDICINE BASKET strapped to the back, visible beside one shoulder, with two broad bundled medicinal leaves and one paper-wrapped herb bundle, no forest of fine grass. Basket woven structure indicated by only 3–4 broad horizontal bands and a few vertical ribs. Near hand holds the shoulder strap at chest level. Other hand carries ONE small shallow wooden herbal tray at waist with three broad leaf shapes inside, fingers supporting underside. Correct two arms and grounded stance.
The design emphasizes upright bamboo-like verticals, diagonal working clothes, practical tidy sleeves and a distinctive back silhouette, clearly unlike a petal-cape girl or a round-gourd wanderer. Keep all skin/clothing wholesome and task-oriented. Project clean gem-icon broad masses, minimal clutter and no dense facets.

DESIGN C — CINNABAR GOURD WANDERER / 葫芦行医. Lively self-assured young female traveling healer with warm CHESTNUT hair cut into a short uneven bob and a small HALF-UP KNOT at the back, ONE simple ivory cloth headband tied with two short ends, no high leaf crown, no flower ornament and no giant bun. Warm amber eyes, slightly upturned soft eyebrows, cheerful small open smile, two tiny freckles only.
Palette CINNABAR RED, warm IVORY, charcoal and natural golden-brown gourd; one small olive leaf accent. Practical Chinese red short wrap jacket with a broad ivory diagonal collar, one asymmetrical black shoulder shawl ending in a single curved tip, broad plain ivory cuffs. Dark-red cloth sash with a simple bronze ring fastener. Two SHORT unequal curved front coat panels over full ivory roomy trousers tapering into dark low travel boots; no petal skirt and no leaf-bob girl's costume.
Dominant prop: one LARGE WARM BROWN DOUBLE-BELLIED MEDICINE GOURD hugged against the near hip/torso, with only a thick simple cord around its waist and ONE dark-green leaf emblem on lower belly. One hand supports its lower round belly, other rests around the narrow neck; believable hands and weight. Do not add a basket or medicine case. Small cloth pouch tucked under belt only.
Graphic rhythm: short angled hair and jacket over the large round gourd, compact separate trousers/boots and one broad red coat tail. Friendly adventurous healer, calm grounded three-quarter left stance with mild weight shift, not jumping. Clean bold broad gem-icon planes, few details, wholesome fully clothed design.
